description: Register a GorgiasResource wrapping Gorgias's REST API (HTTP Basic Auth) for use by other components

resource_key.label: Resource Key
resource_key.description: Key used to register this resource. Other components reference it via resource_key.

subdomain.label: Subdomain
subdomain.description: Gorgias account subdomain, e.g. 'acme' for https://acme.gorgias.com

email_env_var.label: Email Env Var
email_env_var.description: Env var holding the Gorgias account email used as the Basic Auth username

api_key_env_var.label: API Key Env Var
api_key_env_var.description: Env var holding the Gorgias REST API key (Settings > REST API)

name: Gorgias Resource
